free_tier.stated: Launch: USD 30 of credits, one time, valid 90 days (about 300 browser hours at USD 0.10 an hour). Metered by browser session time from session start until release or timeout, billed by the second; no page allowance is stated. Concurrency and session length are in limits.
free_tier.notes: one-time credit valid for 90 days; no credit card required; CAPTCHA solving and Steel-provided proxies on Launch need a USD 10 paid deposit, which free credits do not cover

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a browser session

retention.stated: session data is kept 7 days on Launch; the USD 30 credit expires after 90 days

interface_detail: REST sessions and a scrape route; 10 concurrent sessions and 60 session creates a minute on Launch, with a separate 20-a-minute limit for /scrape, /screenshot and /pdf per client IP address
tooling: a session model with a browser control protocol
chaining: A session model, so it is the wrong shape for a Worker and the right shape for a long agent run
